title: Predictive Maintenance System (Visual Inspection)
summary: A production-grade predictive maintenance platform that generates synthetic industrial sensor data, trains AutoGluon failure-prediction models, and serves real-time equipment monitoring through a web dashboard. It uses SDV's CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers (sdv.single_table) with SingleTableMetadata to augment scarce machine sensor data, and sdmetrics' QualityReport/KSComplement to validate the synthetic output.
